## Summary
- Allow same-actor self-approval when both AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE and AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE are enabled
- Record same-actor approvals as current-head self-approval status comments and let self-merge trust those comments alongside review approvals
- Carry HUMAN_DECISION provenance through self-approval resolution and update docs/prompts/tests

## Tests
- npm --prefix .agent test
- git diff --check

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #299 enables Sepo full self-governance self-approval mode: when both `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE` and `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE` are enabled, same-actor approval can be recorded as a status comment instead of a native GitHub review. It extends self-merge to treat current-head Sepo-authored approval status comments as approval evidence alongside normal review approvals. It also carries `HUMAN_DECISION` provenance into self-approval resolution so the approval gate can decide when a current-head synthesis intentionally requested human judgment. The PR updates workflow env, prompts, docs, and tests for this mode.

## Review

The overall direction fits the intended double opt-in trust model, and the rubrics review found the authorization and provenance shape acceptable. However, the current status-comment parsing weakens the deterministic merge gate, so this needs a branch fix before merge.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Status-comment approvals can be spoofed through free-form text | BLOCKING | [`.agent/src/self-merge.ts#L117`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/a6c97b3167eaba3a1144cabf97d2f0adbc1dcfc5/.agent/src/self-merge.ts#L117) scans the entire status comment for an approved row, including model-controlled reason and handoff text from non-approved outcomes. A non-approved current-head status comment could therefore be misread as approval provenance. |
| Recommended-next-step normalization is confusing | WARNING | [`.agent/src/cli/resolve-self-approve.ts#L77`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/a6c97b3167eaba3a1144cabf97d2f0adbc1dcfc5/.agent/src/cli/resolve-self-approve.ts#L77) uses `normalizeTargetKind` for `SOURCE_RECOMMENDED_NEXT_STEP`; it works mechanically, but the name obscures intent and differs from the prepare path’s generic token normalization. |

## Progress

- Rubrics review passed all selected rubrics, including dual opt-in same-actor approval, separation of decision gates from privileged actions, and trusted runtime handling.
- The PR already adds tests for same-actor self-governance mode, `HUMAN_DECISION` resolver provenance, and self-merge acceptance of current-head status comments.
- No existing inline review comments or review threads were present before synthesis; I posted one new inline comment on `.agent/src/self-merge.ts:117`.
- No inline comments were replied to, minimized, or resolved.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Status-comment approvals can be spoofed through free-form text</summary>

**Cause:** `isApprovedSelfApprovalBody()` checks for the Sepo status marker and an approved table row anywhere in the comment body. Non-approved self-approval status comments still include resolver-controlled head markers plus free-form `reason`/handoff text, so that free-form text can contain the approved row pattern.

**Candidate solutions:** Parse only the canonical status table row emitted by `formatSelfApprovalBody()`, or add a dedicated resolver-controlled approval marker/conclusion field that is emitted only on the approved path. Add a negative regression test for a `REQUEST_CHANGES` or `BLOCKED` status comment containing the approved-row text outside the canonical status row.

**Comments:** This is the main reviewer disagreement: one review considered the design sound overall, while another flagged this trust-boundary issue as blocking. The current code supports the blocking interpretation because self-merge consumes these comments as approval evidence.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Recommended-next-step normalization is confusing</summary>

**Cause:** `resolve-self-approve.ts` reuses `normalizeTargetKind()` to normalize `SOURCE_RECOMMENDED_NEXT_STEP`, even though the value is not a target kind.

**Candidate solutions:** Rename the helper to a generic `normalizeToken()`, or add a local generic normalizer matching `prepare-self-approve.ts`.

**Comments:** This is non-blocking and not included as required automation work, but it is a low-risk cleanup if the branch is already being changed.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`FIX_PR`: the status-comment parsing issue is a concrete branch change and is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict

NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items

- [ ] Restrict self-merge approval detection to a deterministic approved status signal and add a negative regression test for spoofed approved-row text in non-approved self-approval comments.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #299 enables full self-governance self-approval mode when both `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE` and `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE` are enabled. In that mode, same-actor approvals are recorded as Sepo-authored status comments because GitHub cannot accept a same-actor review approval. Self-merge then trusts current-head self-approval status comments alongside normal self-approval reviews. The PR also updates `HUMAN_DECISION` self-approval provenance handling, workflow env wiring, docs, prompts, and tests.

## Review
The double opt-in direction and deterministic resolver ownership are the right shape, and the prior table-row spoofing issue was partially addressed. However, the current approved-head marker is still parsed from model-controlled status text, so the merge approval gate remains spoofable and needs a branch fix before merge.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Status-comment approval marker can be spoofed through free-form text | BLOCKING | [`.agent/src/self-merge.ts#L160`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d7881b421db02433fdef8ccf02ebd6e7f732d400/.agent/src/self-merge.ts#L160) extracts the approved-head marker from the entire status comment body. Since [`.agent/src/self-approval.ts#L407`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d7881b421db02433fdef8ccf02ebd6e7f732d400/.agent/src/self-approval.ts#L407) writes model-controlled reason and follow-up text before the footer, a non-approved status can inject the marker and be trusted as approval evidence. |
| Recommended-next-step normalization is confusing | WARNING | [`.agent/src/cli/resolve-self-approve.ts#L77`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d7881b421db02433fdef8ccf02ebd6e7f732d400/.agent/src/cli/resolve-self-approve.ts#L77) uses `normalizeTargetKind()` for `SOURCE_RECOMMENDED_NEXT_STEP`. Behavior is currently correct, but the helper name obscures intent and could become fragile if target-kind normalization later diverges. |

## Progress
- The PR replaced the old table-row approval detector with `sepo-agent-self-approval-approved-head` markers and added a regression test for spoofed `| Approved |` table-row text.
- Reviewer outputs disagreed: one reviewer considered the marker approach sufficient, while another flagged marker spoofing through free-form status text. The current code supports the blocking marker-spoof finding.
- Posted one new inline comment on [`.agent/src/self-merge.ts#L160`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/d7881b421db02433fdef8ccf02ebd6e7f732d400/.agent/src/self-merge.ts#L160).
- Minimized the older same-agent inline comment on the removed `isApprovedSelfApprovalBody()` implementation as outdated. No replies were added and no review threads were resolved.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Status-comment approval marker can be spoofed through free-form text</summary>

**Cause:** `extractSelfApprovalApprovedHeadSha()` matches `<!-- sepo-agent-self-approval-approved-head: ... -->` anywhere in the status comment body. `formatSelfApprovalBody()` includes `reason` and non-approved `handoffContext` before the deterministic marker footer, so a `REQUEST_CHANGES` or `BLOCKED` status can include the approved-head marker in free-form text and self-merge will treat it as approval evidence.

**Candidate solutions:** Parse only a deterministic resolver-owned footer shape, or sanitize Sepo self-approval marker syntax out of all free-form status fields before posting. Add a negative regression test for a non-approved self-approval status whose reason or follow-up context contains `sepo-agent-self-approval-approved-head` for the current head.

**Comments:** The existing new tests cover the old approved-row spoof, but not marker spoofing. This matters because status comments become merge authorization evidence in full self-governance mode.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Recommended-next-step normalization is confusing</summary>

**Cause:** `resolve-self-approve.ts` reuses `normalizeTargetKind()` to normalize a recommended-next-step value, while the prepare side uses a generic token normalizer.

**Candidate solutions:** Rename the helper to a generic `normalizeToken()`, or add a local generic normalizer for `SOURCE_RECOMMENDED_NEXT_STEP`.

**Comments:** This is not security-critical and should not block the required spoofing fix, but it is low-risk cleanup if the branch is already changing.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
`FIX_PR`: the marker-spoof issue is a concrete branch change with a clear regression test target and is safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Restrict self-merge approval detection to resolver-owned approved status evidence or sanitize self-approval marker syntax from free-form fields, then add a regression test for approved-head marker spoofing in a non-approved self-approval status.

@sepo-agent /answer just want to confirm, so when we enable both allow self approval and self merge, the agent can then approve and merge one pr when it concludes to merge?

Yes, with the important caveat that it is still gated, not an unconditional merge.

With both repository vars enabled:

- `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true`
- `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE=true`

Sepo can take a PR through self-approval and then self-merge when the chain concludes `APPROVED`/merge. For same-actor PRs, it records an internal current-head self-approval status comment instead of a native GitHub review approval, because GitHub does not allow that same-actor review approval path. See the config/docs here: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/0a727e713a7d729ef03f7c2b5e655f81d4bc0ae3/.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md#L13-L14 and https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/0a727e713a7d729ef03f7c2b5e655f81d4bc0ae3/.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md#L283-L310

It still only merges if the PR head matches the approved head, approval evidence is trusted/current-head, there are no requested-changes or failed-check blockers, and GitHub reports the PR mergeable or auto-merge eligible. The self-merge handoff happens only after self-approval returns `approved` and self-merge is enabled: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/0a727e713a7d729ef03f7c2b5e655f81d4bc0ae3/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L527-L532
